authority.value: The board administers and enforces ORS 479.510 to 479.945; prepares examinations; approves rules in conjunction with the Director; approves continuing education programs; establishes equivalent experience standards; approves testing laboratories; may impose civil penalties.
authority.quote: The Electrical and Elevator Board shall administer and enforce ORS 479.510 to 479.945 and 479.995.

credential_type.quote: "License" means a permit issued by the department under ORS 479.630 authorizing the person whose name appears as licensee thereon to act as an electrical contractor, supervising electrician, journeyman electrician, electrical apprentice or limited elevator journeyman as indicated thereon.

is_mandatory.quote: a person may not: (1) Without an electrical contractor's license, engage in the business of making electrical installations

title_protection.quote: Without an electrical contractor's license, engage in the business of making electrical installations, advertise as or otherwise purport to be licensed to make electrical installations or purport to be acting as a business that makes electrical installations.

scope_protection.quote: Except as provided in subsection (5) of this section, make any electrical installation without a supervising or journeyman electrician's license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Civil penalty may be imposed for any violation of ORS 479.510 to 479.945 or rules adopted for administration or enforcement thereof.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Electrical and Elevator Board may impose a civil penalty for a violation of ORS 479.510 to 479.945 or rules adopted for the administration or enforcement of ORS 479.510 to 479.945 and this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: No person shall make, supervise or direct the making of an electrical installation which does not meet minimum safety standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: no person shall make, supervise or direct the making of an electrical installation which does not meet minimum safety standards.

disciplinary_grounds.description: No person shall remove, transfer, alter or otherwise tamper with an inspection permit, label, tag or other indicia of inspection placed on or at an electrical job site.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: no person shall remove, transfer, alter or otherwise tamper with an inspection permit, label, tag or other indicia of inspection placed on or at an electrical job site, electrical installation or electrical product.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A person may not obstruct or interfere with the department in performance of its duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person may not obstruct or interfere with the department in performance of any of the department's duties or the exercise of any authority conferred under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A person may not permit or suffer any electrical installation on property they own, control, manage or supervise to be made by an unlicensed person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permit or suffer any electrical installation on property that the person owns, controls, manages or supervises to be made by a person not licensed to make such an installation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The board may not issue a license to a person whose practical experience qualification is based on out-of-state training or experience not equivalent to Oregon standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board may not administer an examination to, and the Department of Consumer and Business Services may not issue any license to, a person whose practical experience qualification for the license is based upon training or experience in another state if the board determines that the training or experience is not equivalent to the standards for electrical training programs prescribed in this state.

definition_quote.value: "Electrical installations" means the construction or installation of electrical wiring and the permanent attachment or installation of electrical products in or on any structure that is not itself an electrical product. "Electrical installation" also means the maintenance or repair of installed electrical wiring and permanently attached electrical products.

residential_project_definition.value: Single and multifamily dwelling units not exceeding three floors above grade; the first floor is the floor designed for human habitation with 50 percent or more of its perimeter level with or above finished grade of the exterior wall line.
residential_project_definition.quote: a person licensed under this subsection shall perform the electrical work allowed by the license only on single and multifamily dwelling units not exceeding three floors above grade. For purposes of this subsection, the first floor of a building is the floor that is designed for human habitation and that has 50 percent or more of its perimeter level with or above finished grade of the exterior wall line.

qualifier_license_requirement_by_contrac.quote: A licensed electrical contractor or an agent the contractor has designated to the department or the department's designated agent in a record signed by the electrical contractor. The department or department's designated agent shall only issue a permit under this subsection if the application for the permit is accompanied by a signed statement that the electrical contractor's general supervising electrician of record will sign the permit before an inspection of the electrical work is requested.

approved_continuing_education_providers.quote: The Electrical and Elevator Board shall approve the Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Training Program (EVITP), and review equivalent training programs for consideration, as a continuing education program that meets the continuing education standards established by the board under ORS 479.680 (1).

solar_panel_electrical_work_exemption.quote: A person licensed under this subsection may, while in the employ of a licensed electrical contractor or a limited renewable energy contractor: (a) Install, maintain, replace or repair electrical wiring and electrical products that convey energy from or operate on renewable electrical energy generation systems that use wind, solar energy systems, microhydroelectricity, photovoltaic systems or fuel cells

utility_worker_exemption.quote: An electrical contractor license is not required in connection with an electrical installation: ...
